subject: chem
title: Atoms, Molecules and Stoichiometry
subtitle: Atoms, Molecules and Stoichiometry with core theory, reaction logic, and exam-focused application.
concept: Stoichiometry connects chemical equations to measurable quantities. Balanced equations give particle ratios, and the mole converts those ratios into masses, volumes, and concentrations.
This works because one mole of any substance contains the same number of particles. Once everything is converted to moles, reaction math becomes a ratio problem.
Exam success in this topic comes from disciplined unit handling. Most errors come from skipping conversions, especially cm3 to dm3 and formula mass calculations.
